ui_label: Horizontal grid cell with a tripolar grid type.
description: Cells centred on the x-velocity (u) points of the MOM6 Arakawa-C grid on the nominal 0.5 degree tripolar grid, i.e. the midpoints of the eastern and western faces of the tracer cells (tracer cells: see the MOM6 0.5 degree mass grid cell, alias MOM6-0.5deg-mass). There are 720 x 576 = 414720 unique points, one per tracer cell; the model stores 721 x 576 values with symmetric memory because the zonally periodic boundary column is held twice.
